phone_access_token = phone_login['access_token']
print('Phone login successful')

robert_contacts = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access_token, query='Robert', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    robert_contacts.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print(robert_contacts)
